# downpipe/0.1.0 archive format

This is a versioned pointer, not the full specification. Recover with the destination bucket bytes, your offline break-glass key, and a conformant reader of the downpipe/0.1.0 format. The authoritative specification (docs/format/SPEC.md) and the normative conformance vectors (internal/format/testdata/vectors) are the open-source MIT downpipe project; use its reader or build a clean-room one from the spec and vectors. Neither Cloudflare nor the vendor is involved.

This archive names the format version it is, above, and deliberately names no minimum reader version. A reader's release number is a separate number space from the format and says nothing about it: of the two released reader tags, the newer implements downpipe/0.1.x while the older implements a different format version and refuses this one. To find a reader that opens this archive, read each release's CHANGELOG.md entry, which names the format versions that release reads (https://github.com/downpipes-io/downpipe), then prove it by running a verify against these bytes before you rely on the binary. Any minimum reader version written here would be a promise made about releases that did not exist when this archive was sealed.
